content.title: Wight Fortress
content.body:
A note I found, written by someone else in the past:

"After my encounter in the tower, I crossed a muddy marshland. All I could see was a bleak flatness for the longest time... and then suddenly, there it was. No doubt one of the largest standing forts of the empire.

I approached and entered warily, still very aware of the possibility that everything imaginable would instantly try to kill me. At first, there was a strange... quietness about the place. But just as I approached a pot to smash it, I heard a demented scream, and some skeletal creature burst out of the side of the wall, scratching me.

In horror shock, I quickly smashed the pot, which only had sme rope, and ran out. No more of this madness. I can't afford to be tempted by danger anymore."
